_comment: Sample Adobe Target Form-Based (JSON) offers for the landing page. Create one JSON offer per scope in Target (Offers > Create > JSON Offer) and assign it to the experience for that decision scope. Each top-level key is the decision scope / mbox name (matches a handler in scripts/target.js). Field names inside `set` match that block's fieldMap. `_note` keys are documentation only — omit them from the real offer.

hero._note: Block-level fields. Omit any field you don't want to change.

set.heading: Energy that works as hard as you do — Experience A
set.subtitle: Fair, transparent pricing and 100% renewable supply for homes and businesses across the UK.

metrics._note: Item collection. `match.item` selects a metric by its current label text; `set` updates that item's value/label/change.

stats._note: Item collection matched by label. Update value and/or label.

match.item: Avg. annual saving vs big six

set.label: Avg. annual saving vs big six

feature-cards._note: Block-level header fields for the feature-cards section.

set.label: Why switch to Xcel
set.heading: Green energy, made simple and honest — Experience A
set.subtitle: No exit fees, no bill shock, no asterisks. Just fair energy powered by wind, solar, and hydro.

usage-dashboard._note: Block-level fields. `cta` is only applied if this dashboard instance has a CTA link.

set.label: Smart metering
set.heading: Your meter. Your data. Your control. — Experience A
